headline: Francesca Polverino: elected European Respiratory Society National Delegate for the United States
dek: Francesca Polverino announced on LinkedIn her election as the European Respiratory Society's National Delegate for the US, citing aims of closer US-European collaboration.
body:
Francesca Polverino has been elected as the European Respiratory Society (ERS) National Delegate for the United States, she announced on LinkedIn.

Polverino, whose profile lists her as Lester and Sue Smith Professor of Medicine at Baylor College of Medicine and Medical Spokesperson for the American Lung Association, wrote that she had just received the news of her election.

She said she looks forward to "strengthening collaborations between US and Europe and advancing respiratory research and education". She also thanked everyone who voted for her.
key_quote: I look forward to strengthening collaborations between US and Europe and advancing respiratory research and education.
